title: /help knows every site starts with "Initial backup — site as built" and never says there is nothing earlier to go back to
steps: S1: Build the Help system prompt (systemPrompt) with no asker context.
expect: S1: it states that every site starts with one backup already made and names it "Initial backup — site as built", the name Site changes shows (tracy-site-tabs strings backup.initialName).
evidence: 16/10/2026 local stand: "/help How do I undo a change … can I get my old site back?" answered that a backup the person had not made left nothing earlier to go back to, while Site changes listed "Initial backup — site as built · Full backup"
fence: The product facts are the only facts Help knows; the backup fact must be among them

tests: Help prompt knows every site starts with the Initial backup
